question.text: Stock's P/E is 15 and median sector P/E is 22. Stock appears:

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 50 illustrates relative valuation with a target-company P/E of 18 versus industry/market/comparable-firm P/E of 22 judged undervalued; a lower P/E than peers indicates relative undervaluation. The Trap: A higher P/E than peers would suggest overvaluation. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A pages 50-52, with the caveats those pages discuss for P/E and PEG.
